verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal client. Managing Git submodules is a source-control capability outside its product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Termius ships any Git or submodule features. Running git commands inside a remote shell would be a user-side workaround on the host, not a Termius capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can clone, update, and manage Git submodules within a repository
